verdict.rationale: Activepieces is an open-source Zapier replacement with documented TypeScript piece-building and fast local dev iteration, so developers can create and add their own integrations. The founder also frames the project as a reaction to closed app ecosystems. The pack never explicitly shows community-contributed pieces or a way to install third-party pieces from outside the vendor. missing for 10: explicit documentation of installing community/third-party pieces (e.g., npm or private piece install), evidence of a community contribution model or marketplace, independent hands-on corroboration.
